content: We used Stanford CoreNLP BIBREF12 library to write rules for extracting lexical answer type present in the question, both 'parts of speech'(POS) and dependency parsing functionality was used. We incorporated the Lexical Answer Type into one of our systems, UNCC_QA1 in Batch 4. This system underperformed our system FACTOIDS by about 3% in the MRR measure, but corrected errors such as in the example above.
